items.intent: Remove special NFS item contracts from 2026-12-06
transformationChain: The change removes symbolic-link, block-device, character-device, FIFO, and socket item models, their XML collections, related NFS metadata, and special-file values. Directory listing and file creation retain their routes but lose nested response elements and accepted type values.

changes.summary: Remove special NFS item contracts from 2026-12-06

aspects.field: special NFS request and response surface
aspects.before: The 2026-12-06 API included special-file values, item models, XML collections, and related metadata.
aspects.after: Those values, models, collections, and metadata are removed from the same API version.

findings.title: Operation parameter contract changes
findings.summary: The compact type remains array<string>, but the source removes special-file include values from the existing API contract.

findings.title: Operation response contract changes
findings.summary: The top-level schema name is stable, but its XML payload loses five collections and their item models, breaking consumers of existing 2026-12-06 responses.
evidence: Directory_ListFilesAndDirectoriesSegment changed an existing response contract.

findings.title: Operation parameter contract changes
findings.summary: The header remains summarized as string, but previously supported x-ms-file-file-type values are removed.

findings.title: REST contract changes require generated-client updates
findings.summary: The approved REST contract changes also alter generated client request or response handling and can break callers compiled against the previous contract.
